purpose: Present a citizen-readable history of approved property answer snapshots, showing publication dates, material changes, reasons for changes and the currently operative version while preserving the underlying audit chain.
core_principle: ANSWER HISTORY → VERSION → WHAT CHANGED → WHY → CURRENT OPERATIVE VERSION
rules: Every material revision links to its predecessor.
Version ordering reflects publication history and does not imply legal correctness or quality ranking.
Only approved snapshots enter the citizen-facing history.
A superseded answer remains historical and is not silently presented as current.
Current operative status is based on publication state, not merely the newest timestamp.
Material changes identify whether the cause was evidence, legal source, procedure, deadline, correction or another approved change type.
Unchanged material components remain visible where useful.
Historical versions retain their original scope, dates and legal-source versions.
Private case information and restricted evidence are excluded from public history.
hard_stops: Never manufacture a version history from timestamps alone.
Never treat the newest version as correct merely because it is newest.
Never expose restricted evidence or internal audit metadata.
Never change historical wording or scope while displaying it as an original version.
